Olivia Park: Quick note: Candidate Tasha Rivera (Product Designer) is visiting Fri 2025-05-23. She asked about campus childcare drop-in info and whether we have a quiet corner for breastfeeding besides the lactation room. Any guidance?
Samir Desai: We don't have on-site childcare but we can provide a list of nearby drop-in centers. I'll DM the list to Olivia.
Olivia Park: Thanks. Also she prefers to have a recruiter escort from reception to the room. Can someone cover?
Priya Shah: I can meet at reception at 09:10 to escort.
FacilitiesBot: Auto-response: Lactation room reserved (private room 1) from 09:00-12:00. List of nearby childcare centers posted to People Ops doc. Reception escort noted.
Olivia Park: Great. Draft invite snippet: 
Subject: Redwood Onsite Interview  Tasha Rivera
When: Fri May 23, 09:30 arrival, interviews 10:00-12:00
Location: Redwood HQ 3rd floor, Design Studio
Notes: Lactation room available (private room 1). Recruiter escort at reception at 09:10 (Priya Shah). Nearby childcare options sent via DM.
Priya Shah: Confirmed. Also will have a sweater available in case the candidate needs it (building is cool). :sweat_smile:
Samir Desai: One more: please include reimbursement instructions for transit if needed. Olivia will add.
